title: Nine Feet of Iron
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：bed　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bed 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my grandmother was given ① a bed by a cousin who was leaving, and she said the giving was the whole of the cousin. The ② bed, meaning the frame and not the sleep, was nine feet long and too wide for any room in the house; a bed, she said, is the only piece of furniture that is measured by what happens when you are not looking at it.

Every ③ bed in that house was shared, and the ④ bed by the window, meaning the one for the illness and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever died in. A bed, my mother said, is nine parts habit and one part a view you did not choose; my grandmother said the habit is the part that keeps you there.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bed was the whole of the garden, meaning the plot and not the frame. The ⑥ bed, meaning the strip of dug earth and not any of that, is the only piece of ground that is planted and never walked on; a bed, he said, is either something you sleep in or the only word that means both a frame and a plot. She said the plot came first.

By 1965 the ⑦ bed had become a photograph in an inventory, and the inventory had become an argument about who had slept where. The ⑧ bed of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was nine feet of iron and eleven years of sharing; a bed, she said, is either the frame by the window or the reason you learned to be quiet. He said the quiet was the part that mattered.

The ⑨ bed I remember is the one by the window, which was sold in 1968 and never replaced. A ⑩ bed, my mother said in 1970, is the only furniture that improves by being shared; every bed, she said, is a plot that has agreed to look like a frame. She said the plot was always the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 床（指那张床架，与睡眠相对）
C. 固定搭配：be given a bed 得到一张床
D. n. 床（指屋里每一张）
E. n. 床（指窗边那一张）
F. n. 花坛；苗床（指园里那块地）
G. n. 花坛（抽象：翻好的那块土）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bed by a cousin who was leaving
The bed, meaning the frame and not the sleep
bed was the whole of the garden
The bed, meaning the strip of dug earth
the bed had become a photograph in an inventory
The bed of the whole thing
A bed, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: be given a bed 意为“得到一张床”，1946 年一个要离开的表亲把一张床给了祖母，她说送床就是这个表亲的全部。
bed 意为“床”，指那张床架而不是睡眠，它长九英尺，宽得这屋里哪间房都放不下。
bed 指屋里每一张床，那屋里每一张都是合睡的。
bed 指窗边那一张（生病时睡的那一张），是唯一有人在上面离世的。
bed 意为“花坛、苗床”，指园里那块地，父亲说 bed 就是那个园子的全部。
bed 为抽象用法，指翻好的那块土，是唯一被种上东西却从不被踩踏的一块地。
bed 意为“床”，到 1965 年这个 bed 成了清单里的一张照片。
bed 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英尺的铁和十一年的合睡。
bed 意为“床”，我记得的是窗边那一张，1968 年被卖掉，再没补上。
bed 为抽象总称，母亲说床是唯一会因为共用而变好的家具。
